scripts.dev:api:local: npm run build:shared && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit false --outDir tmp/api-dist --rootDir . && node --env-file=apps/api/.dev.vars --env-file=.env.local scripts/dev-api.mjs
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @app/web run build
scripts.build:vercel: npm run typecheck && npm --workspace @app/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:shared && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:vercel
scripts.test:catalog: npm --workspace @app/api run test:catalog && npm --workspace @app/web run test
scripts.verify:production: npm run typecheck && npm run test:catalog && npm run build:web
